_comment: Page rules -- what a fetched page has to say for a listing to count as gone. Separate file from brokers.json on purpose: this one rots on a designer's schedule, not a company's, and bundling them would bump the roster's version every time a broker A/B tests a footer. Every rule needs a fingerprint (is this the broker's page at all), a present list and an absent list. Re-read them against the live page and bump 'reviewed'. A broker with NO rule here is a normal state -- it means its listings can be fetched but not read, and the app says so rather than guessing.

absent: we could not find anyone matching
this profile is no longer available
rules.notes: Placeholder. Shape reference only -- not a real broker. Note the fingerprint is ONE stable string from the site chrome, not a list of five: every entry is another thing that can rot, and a rotted fingerprint refuses every check on this broker. needs_needle is on because listing pages here are per-person, so a presence marker without the person's own details is the template rather than the listing.
